body:
In the first 12 minutes of opening sequence you got heartbreak, action, drama, beautiful actors, good food, funny dialog, lovely scenes and DOGGIES!!

What more can you ask for!? No f bombs every 5 minutes, no panic attack inducing scenes, I am sooooo glad they used a realndog and not that compiter generated crap they are using nowadays. I grew up watching Lassie and Benji and Petey (little rascals), Luke (Buster Keaton) and seeing how they want to replace them with A. I. just bugs me to no end.

Anyway, watch this one!!

A story that combines human love in animals and life. Well done, especially the main actor did a great job. Congratulations. The nice dog Caramelo played his part wonderfully too.. The movie sends a great message for courage and how important is a solid friendship in those situations. It will open your eyes to tell you hey man look, there are people suffering of bad maladies.i had tears in my eyes. God bless all who needs health.

Watch it. 7/10.

"Caramel" is a deeply heart-touching film that beautifully portrays the bond between a dog and its caretaker. The love, loyalty, and emotions they share are shown with such warmth that it truly moves you. Pedro's kindness and the dog's pure expressions form the soul of the story. It's an emotional journey that makes time fly, and every dog lover will find a piece of their own story in it. A heartfelt tribute to the unconditional love of dogs.

---

Sweet and adorable movie about a dog. No profanity, nudity, drugs, sex etc. Very clean.

The dog is adorable

Is best to watch it in the native language Portuguese than with English audio.

It follows the life of a Dog named Caramelo, and the struggles and challenges of the people in his life.

By all standards (human and dog) it was a good life.

What was meant to be a random watch became meaningful. I am not too familliar with Brazilian movies so this is considered a new endeavor for me?

The plot is as simple as it gets, a guy just trying to get by randomly meets a dog and they form a bond. Simple since that's the whole plot, though it's greatly enhanced by the execution.

Some may find the beginning of the film a little rough in terms of events. On that note, the 2nd half of the movie was great. Lots of precise, spot on moments of understanding love, goals, dreams, and reality.

"What if the cure is getting to be here?"

Peak.
